verdict.rationale: Poly has no documented general-purpose public API: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all return 404, and the docs state there are no API keys. Its documented programmatic surfaces are a hosted MCP endpoint (`https://mcp.poly.app/mcp`, streamable HTTP with OAuth) and a scriptable local `poly` CLI. These let an AI-native user drive files programmatically, but only through agent and CLI channels rather than a conventional API. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL public API, an API reference or OpenAPI spec, API-key or token-based programmatic auth, and independent corroboration of programmatic use.
